init_mllm_mixin: create an MLLMMixin compressor instance with processor and image_processor overrides for a vision-language model
calibrate_mllm_model: run MLLM-specific calibration on a multi-modal model using a template and dataset for quantization
save_quantized_mllm: save a quantized multi-modal LLM to an output directory with processor and image_processor artifacts
configure_quant_nontext_module: build an MLLMMixin compressor that quantizes non-text vision modules by setting quant_nontext_module to true
review_mllm_calib_data_handling: review the MLLMMixin calib method to understand how it processes string, dict, and tensor data formats
